cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Sit down, love. You've been on the ward all night. I'll bring lunch. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Just catching a drip. Take the sofa; I've made you a tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay here. I'll bring your duvet down; upstairs needs a little drying before I put your bed back.

mechanism: A confidently arranges rest for an exhausted partner while quietly adapting the resting place to hide a larger leak A intends to handle alone.
confusable: Unlike hiding blame, the stated motive must be sparing a tired person work; authority depends on making the alternative rest comfortable enough to accept.
comparison: Care after a hospital shift and domestic leak differ from preserving a day off while collecting scattered bicycle parts.
seedUse: Use canonical D39-a ward shift/bucket/sofa/bed and S02-b accommodating preferences beneath a caretaker plan.
